subject: Security exhibit scope & redline turnaround — SOC2 / pen-test questions
messages:
From: Grace Miller <gmiller@mediqhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MediQ Health Procurement <procurement@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial security questionnaire + pen-test / audit rights clarifications

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — product looked very promising. Procurement asked me to send our security questionnaire and to get clarity on a few contract items before we proceed to legal redlines:

- SOC 2: Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent 12-month period? If so, can you share the report and the date range covered?
- Pen tests: We typically require at least an annual third-party pen test and a mechanism to validate fixes. Will Redwood allow us to either receive the pen-test report or run our own audit (with a mutually agreed limited scope and non-disruptive approach)?
- Audit rights & evidence cadence: Our security team asks for quarterly evidence for change control and monthly access logs for the last 6 months during procurement review. Would Redwood be able to provide this cadence?

I've attached our questionnaire (MediQ_Security_Questionnaire_20270401.pdf) — we filled the obvious fields but left vendor responses blank. Can you point me to the right person on your side for contract redlines (MSA + order form) and the expected turnaround once we exchange redlines?

Thanks,
Grace Miller
Security Programs Manager
MediQ Health

Attachment: MediQ_Security_Questionnaire_20270401.pdf (pdf, 128KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace Miller <gmiller@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial security questionnaire + pen-test / audit rights clarifications

Hi Grace — great to connect.

Welcome — and thanks for sending the questionnaire. Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Yes — we completed a SOC 2 Type II for 10/2025–10/2026. We can share the report under an NDA; I will coordinate that with legal.
- Pen tests: Redwoods runs annual third-party pen tests and we also do targeted internal assessments between cycles. We are generally able to share executive summaries and the remediation status; we prefer redacted reports for vendor confidentiality but will discuss scope-specific sharing.
- Evidence cadence: We can provide monthly access logs (rolling 6 months) and quarterly change-control summaries via a shared Drive folder. For production support, we can also set a recurring evidence handoff cadence (quarterly) and an on-demand 48–72 hour access window for limited additional pulls subject to our legal process.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will loop in our legal contact (Karthik) and security lead (Lauren) — copied — to accept the questionnaire and propose contract language.
2) We will prepare a redline bundle (MSA + security exhibit + order form language) and a short pen-test options spreadsheet with proposed windows for November and March (attached).
3) Proposed turnaround: 3 business days for an initial redline packet internally; legal-to-legal turnaround expected 5–7 business days after you return your markups. If procurement needs faster SLA we can prioritize.

Attaching: PenTest_Windows_and_Options.xlsx (spreadsheet) and a placeholder redline we will refine once legal reviews.

Let me know if procurement has any hard-stop dates.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PenTest_Windows_and_Options.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB); (placeholder) Redline_MSA_v1.pdf

From: Grace Miller <gmiller@mediqhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial security questionnaire + pen-test / audit rights clarifications

Hi Sofia and team,

Thanks — that timeline sounds reasonable. A couple of procurement-specific asks to flag so legal can incorporate them into redlines:

- Our standard PO terms request a 60-day invoice payment window; will Redwood accept 60 days for first-year contracts?
- For pen-tests, procurement prefers to receive either (a) a redacted third-party pen-test report with remediation timelines, or (b) to observe an agreed lightweight assessment. Is option (a) possible? If not, we will propose vendor-observed testing into our SOW and share the scope.
- Please include in the security exhibit a section that clarifies evidence retention windows (access logs 6 months, config change history 12 months) — that will help our compliance team sign off faster.

We are trying to get legal a first draft by next week (target: 2027-04-12). If Redwood can provide your redline bundle by Tue 2027-04-06 EOD PST, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Grace

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace Miller <gmiller@mediqhealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial security questionnaire + pen-test / audit rights clarifications

Hi Grace — copying our security and contracts team to be explicit on a few legal points so we don't create surprises during redlines:

1) SOC 2 delivery: We will provide the SOC 2 Type II report under a mutual NDA before signature. Expect a redacted vendor copy (PII and sensitive test artifacts redacted); the report timeframe (10/2025–10/2026) will be called out in the security exhibit.

2) Pen-testing / audit rights: We can accept an annual third-party pen test and will provide an executive summary plus remediation status. For full reports, we ask customers to accept a redacted copy (sensitive exploit details removed). If MediQ requires an observed assessment, we can accommodate limited customer-observed tests with the following guardrails:
   - Scope to be mutually agreed and restricted to non-production-impacting tests
   - 30 days advance notice for scheduling
   - A signed statement that testing will not attempt social-engineering vectors against Redwood employees
   - A data-handling attestation for any exported artifacts

3) Audit window & evidence cadence: Proposed contract language (high-level):
   - Access logs: rolling 6 months retained and provided upon written request subject to standard legal process (e.g., subpoena/approved request).
   - Change-control / config history: 12 months retained; quarterly summary handoffs for jointly-agreed KPIs.
   - Audit executions (on-site or remote): limited to once per 12 months for full-scope audits unless mutually agreed otherwise.

4) Procurement terms: Payment terms (Net30 standard) — we understand 60 days is a request; we can escalate to finance for approval but would need this in the procurement PO or SOW as a negotiated term.

Action items:
- Sofia/legal to deliver Redline_MSA_v1.pdf (includes proposed security exhibit language) by EOD Tue 2027-04-06 — we will target that.
- Grace/procurement to confirm whether option (a) (redacted pen-test report) will satisfy MediQ, or whether you will request a customer-observed assessment; please flag any hard-stop sign dates.

We will also add a short appendix spelling out the evidence request workflow (owner, SLA for delivery, and escalation path).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
